post.description:
### REMARKS

Http request content-type header must be application/x-www-form-urlencoded
grant_type either password or refresh_token
if grant_type is password then you must send user name and password
if grant_type is refresh_token then you must send refresh_token with request body
Sample request body: ```grant_type=password&username=put_user_name_in_here&password=put_user_password_in_here```
if you have refresh token you can get access token without sending user name and password
To test connection use: 
```curl -H "content-type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded" -d "grant_type=password&username=&password=" https://testndbapi.med.kg/connect/token```

QR code type list retrieved
id: The QRcode model ID is id number of QR type
name: Name of the QR type
description: Description of the of QR type. Depending on QR type the order of Data matrix information differs. Ex: For Europe QR type "01GTIN(14) 21SerialNumber(18) 17Expirydate(yymmdd)(6) 10Batchnumber(11)" GTIN is 14 characters length, Serial Number 18 characters length, Expiry date is 6 characters with yymmdd format, Batch number is 11 characters.
